Should the University announce a closure due to inclement weather or emergency scenarios, we will make every effort to remain open. However, there may be times that a staff member is unable to make a shift due to weather or unforeseen conditions (especially in the early morning). Please feel free to call any Fitness Center during these times to check on their status.
